biography_english:
Catiua's true name was Versalia Oberyth. She was the daughter of the Dynast-King and the Queen's handmaiden Mannaflora. Soon after her birth she was taken in by Abuna Prancet and raised in Golyat. She knew nothing of her lineage besides the fact that Prancet was not her true father.
  After the Dark Knight Lanselot revealed the truth to her, Loslorien forced her to accompany them under the pretense of protection. She was later rescued by Resistance forces advancing on Barnicia Castle.
  She sided with the Resistance hoping to bring the war to an end and reclaim her throne, but perished in battle before her plans could be realized.
biography_spanish:
El verdadero nombre de Catiua era Versalia Oberyth. Era hija del rey dinasta y de Mannaflora, sirvienta de la reina. Poco despues de nacer, el abuna Prancet la acogio y la crio en Golyat. No sabia nada de su linaje salvo que Prancet no era su verdadero padre.                        
  Tras revelarle la verdad el caballero oscuro Lanselot, Loslorien la obligo a ir con ellos alegando proteccion. Mas tarde fue rescatada por la Resistencia al avanzar hacia el castillo de Barnicia.        
  Se unio a la Resistencia esperando poner fin a la guerra y reclamar su trono, pero perecio en combate antes de poder realizar sus planes.

A Xenobian born in the city of Valna in Charlom who formerly captained the Holy Knights of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  He was stripped of his status and banished by King Tristan of Xenobia for the misconduct of his knights. He now roams with a small band of fellow knights seeking mercenary work.

biography_english:
A Xenobian born in the city of Valna in Charlom who formerly captained the Holy Knights of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He came to Valeria to recover the sword Brynhildr at the behest of King Tristan of Xenobia.
  He was captured in the Bakram invasion of Rhime, and imprisoned in the dungeon of Heim Castle. It appears he was moved from there before the fall of Heim. There has been no word of him since.
biography_spanish:

  Fue capturado en la invasion bakram de Rhime y encarcelado en la mazmorra del castillo de Heim. Parece que lo trasladaron antes de la caida de Heim. Nada se sabe de el desde entonces.

biography_english:
A Xenobian born in the city of Valna in Charlom who formerly captained the Holy Knights of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He came to Valeria to recover the sword Brynhildr at the behest of King Tristan of Xenobia.
  He was garrisoned in Rhime when the Bakram invaded. Though he fought well, he was overcome by superior numbers, only escaping Rhime through the aid of {hero}. He then took up with the Order of {order} to help them end the war in Valeria.
  Though wounded in a skirmish with the Dark Knights at the Hanging Gardens, he was able to recover Brynhildr.
biography_spanish:
Xenobiano nacido en la ciudad de Valna, Charlom, que fue capitan de los Caballeros Santos del Reino de Nueva Xenobia. Vino a Valeria a recuperar la espada Brynhildr por orden del rey Tristan de Xenobia.        
  Estaba destinado en Rhime cuando invadieron los bakram. Aunque lucho bien, sucumbio ante la superioridad numerica y solo escapo de Rhime gracias a {hero}. Se unio a la Orden de {order} para ayudar a poner fin a la guerra en Valeria.     
  Aunque herido en una escaramuza con los Caballeros Oscuros en los Jardines Colgantes, recupero a Brynhildr.
